001package models;
002
003import java.io.Serializable;
004import java.util.ArrayList;
005import java.util.List;
006import java.util.Objects;
007
008/**
009 * Serializable course entity with teachers, enrolled students, and scheduled lessons.
010 */
011public class Course implements Serializable {
012    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
013
014    private String courseID;
015    private int credits;
016    private List<Teacher> teachers = new ArrayList<>();
017    private List<Student> students = new ArrayList<>();
018    private List<Lesson> lessons = new ArrayList<>();
019    private String major;
020    private int year;
021    private int maxStudents;
022
023    public Course(String courseID, int credits, String major, int year, int maxStudents) {
024        this.courseID = courseID;
025        this.credits = credits;
026        this.major = major;
027        this.year = year;
028        this.maxStudents = maxStudents;
029    }
030
031    public String getCourseID() {
032        return courseID;
033    }
034
035    public int getCredits() {
036        return credits;
037    }
038
039    public String getMajor() {
040        return major;
041    }
042
043    public int getYear() {
044        return year;
045    }
046
047    public int getMaxStudents() {
048        return maxStudents;
049    }
050
051    public boolean hasSpace() {
052        if (students == null) students = new ArrayList<>();
053        return students.size() < maxStudents;
054    }
055
056    public List<Teacher> getTeachers() {
057        if (teachers == null) teachers = new ArrayList<>();
058        return teachers;
059    }
060
061    public List<Student> getStudents() {
062        if (students == null) students = new ArrayList<>();
063        return students;
064    }
065
066    public List<Lesson> getLessons() {
067        if (lessons == null) lessons = new ArrayList<>();
068        return lessons;
069    }
070
071    @Override
072    public String toString() {
073        return "Course{" +
074                "courseID='" + courseID + '\'' +
075                ", credits=" + credits +
076                ", major='" + major + '\'' +
077                ", year=" + year +
078                ", maxStudents=" + maxStudents +
079                ", teachers=" + teachers.size() +
080                ", students=" + students.size() +
081                ", lessons=" + lessons.size() +
082                '}';
083    }
084
085    @Override
086    public boolean equals(Object o) {
087        if (this == o) return true;
088        if (!(o instanceof Course)) return false;
089        Course course = (Course) o;
090        return Objects.equals(courseID, course.courseID);
091    }
092
093    @Override
094    public int hashCode() {
095        return Objects.hash(courseID);
096    }
097}
